Title: No controlled journey amendment or cancellation after departure
Reproduction: Dispatch LEG1 → Edit its planned departure to 11 November → Save: locked after booking → Review record actions: no supported amendment or cancellation
Expected: Controlled versioned amendments and cancellation with revised legs, costs and documents
Actual: Journey legs are locked after booking; no amend/rebook/cancel operation exposed
Recommended fix: Provide versioned amendment/rebooking and cancellation workflows that preserve departed legs, approvals, costs and documents.

Title: Duplicate supplier invoice can become a second posted payable
Reproduction: Use the settled S24 request and its supplier invoice number → Create another request for the same vendor and job → Upload the same invoice number, AED 100 → Approve and post the resulting second bill
Expected: Reject a duplicate vendor/invoice identity or require an explicit audited exception
Actual: Second bill 728 is Posted and unpaid; first bill 699 was already Paid.
Recommended fix: Enforce supplier legal-entity plus normalized invoice-number uniqueness before approval/posting, with a reviewed override.

Screen: Invoice request approval / Reports → Outstanding Payables
Title: Automatic supplier bills and payables report identify the customer organization
Reproduction: Approve a vendor invoice request linked to a customer shipment → Open the generated bill → Open Outstanding Payables
Expected: Identify the supplier as the creditor and keep the shipment customer separately
Actual: BILL-000728 appears against the S24 Customer organization. Vendor login is stored separately, but no supplier organization is linked by approval.
Recommended fix: Add a supplier-organization relationship to vendor accounts/requests/bills and use it in AP reports.

Title: No customs declaration/release workflow or dispatch gate
Reproduction: Inspect customs-required/reference fields → Search menus and shipment actions for clearance/release → Continue the shipment lifecycle without a clearance document
Expected: A clearance record, release/hold status and controlled dispatch
Actual: Only customs fields and a duty report are exposed
Recommended fix: Introduce declarations, entries, attachments, hold/release status and a release gate before dispatch where clearance is required.

Title: Hazardous cargo can progress without structured dangerous-goods acceptance data
Reproduction: Create hazardous inquiry with package dimensions → Inspect DG acceptance fields → Book and dispatch without an approved DG declaration
Expected: Mode-appropriate UN/class/packing instruction and acceptance controls
Actual: Only hazardous flags, free text and attachments are present
Recommended fix: Add structured mode-specific DG data, required supporting documents and an acceptance/release decision before dispatch.

Title: Mode-specific freight documents cannot be generated
Reproduction: Open the saved shipment → Inspect generation/print actions → Only generic Print / save PDF and file attachments are available
Expected: ["B/L","packing list","commercial invoice"]
Actual: ["Print / save PDF"]
Recommended fix: Add versioned mode-specific documents and master/house links with numbering, validation and printable templates.

Title: Truck masters do not provide transport or fleet execution
Reproduction: Inspect truck master fields and road booking form → Look for driver/vehicle assignment, trip sheet, permit, maintenance or POD controls
Expected: Assign and operate fleet trips with resource availability and delivery evidence
Actual: A generic Truck category and free-text carrier/vehicle fields are present; fleet operations are absent.
Recommended fix: Add vehicle/driver/trip records, availability checks and delivery evidence.

Title: One job cannot receive supplier/customer bills in independent currencies
Reproduction: On S22 USD job 927, create an AED customer invoice and save → Open its USD supplier request upload form → Submit a EUR invoice through the authenticated API supplement
Expected: EUR supplier bill and AED customer invoice against the same USD job, with base-currency accounting
Actual: [{"test":"AED customer invoice against USD job","result":"Document currency must match the linked job."},{"test":"EUR supplier invoice against USD job/request","result":{"error":"Invoice totals must be positive, in the request currency, with a PDF or image."},"status":400}]
Recommended fix: Allow document currencies distinct from the job, with dated exchange rates, base-currency ledgers and realized/unrealized FX handling.

Title: Temperature-control flag is lost when a quote becomes a shipment
Reproduction: Create an inquiry with Temperature controlled checked → Prepare and accept the quotation → Convert it to a shipment and inspect the operational details
Expected: Preserve temperature control in the operational job
Actual: {"quote_temperature":true,"shipment_temperature":null}
Recommended fix: Preserve the temperature-control requirement and instructions throughout quote-to-job conversion and printing.

Title: Oversized cargo has no OOG approval, lashing or route-permit workflow
Reproduction: Enter 420 x 280 x 310 cm, 6500 kg → Book and dispatch without OOG approvals
Expected: OOG limits, engineering approval, lashing plan and route permits
Actual: Dimensions are stored but no approval/permit gate is exposed
Recommended fix: Add OOG assessment, permits, engineering/lashing approvals and shipment release requirements.

Title: Dimensions do not calculate volume or chargeable weight
Reproduction: Enter package count and dimensions shown in test data → Save inquiry and prepare quotation without manually entering volume → Read declared volume / chargeable fields
Expected: {"volume":"63.48","chargeable":"63.48"}
Actual: {"gross":"18000","volume":null,"chargeable":null,"expected_volume":"63.48","expected_air_chargeable":"18000","expected_sea_wm":"63.48"}
Recommended fix: Calculate unit-aware volume, gross totals and mode-specific chargeable quantities; support an explicit audited manual override.

Title: Supplier internal line notes disclose buying prices to customers
Reproduction: Vendor: submit a rate with line Note INTERNAL-AUDIT-BUY-<currency>-<cost> → Admin: publish the quotation → Client: open quotation and read the charge Note column
Expected: Vendor pricing notes remain internal
Actual: [{"description":"Audit coordination"},{"description":"LEG1 freight","note":"INTERNAL-AUDIT-BUY-USD-100"}]
Recommended fix: Separate supplier-private notes from customer-facing descriptions and enforce that separation in both API projections and rendering.

Title: No operational workflow for split consignments and partial delivery
Reproduction: Create the scenario enquiry → Inspect booking and shipment actions for the required operation
Expected: split consignments and partial delivery
Actual: No dedicated screen/action found
Recommended fix: Track booked, dispatched, delivered and remaining quantities per consignment and issue partial PODs.

Title: No operational workflow for master/house consolidation
Reproduction: Create the scenario enquiry → Inspect booking and shipment actions for the required operation
Expected: master/house consolidation
Actual: No dedicated screen/action found
Recommended fix: Implement consolidation masters, multiple linked houses, container allocations and manifests.

Title: No operational workflow for groupage and multiple consignees
Reproduction: Create the scenario enquiry → Inspect booking and shipment actions for the required operation
Expected: groupage and multiple consignees
Actual: No dedicated screen/action found
Recommended fix: Implement groupage loads with multiple consignments, consignees and per-consignment delivery.

Title: Generic invoice view lacks an issuable UAE tax-invoice template
Reproduction: Open the taxable AED domestic invoice → Review available issuer, supplier TRN, supply-date and invoice template fields → Review foreign-currency invoice controls
Expected: Produce an appropriate configured tax invoice, including required issuer/recipient details and AED tax presentation where applicable
Actual: The invoice uses the generic record view and has no issuer TRN/address/template configuration or AED tax equivalent for foreign-currency documents.
Recommended fix: Implement configurable legal invoice/credit-note templates with issuer identity, tax treatment and AED equivalents; verify applicable full/simplified/zero-rated exceptions.

Title: Temperature-controlled cargo has no setpoint or excursion workflow
Reproduction: Set Temperature controlled → Enter -18 C in specification → Inspect shipment controls and milestones for temperature monitoring
Expected: Structured setpoint/range, reefer instructions and temperature events
Actual: Temperature checkbox and free-text specification only
Recommended fix: Store setpoint, allowed range, reefer equipment and temperature/excursion events as structured operational data.

Title: Net weight greater than gross weight is accepted
Reproduction: Create a valid quotation → Set gross weight 1000 kg and net weight 2000 kg → Save
Expected: Reject net weight above gross weight
Actual: The quotation saves with gross 1000 and net 2000.
Recommended fix: Validate the relationship on enquiries, quotes, packages and shipments.

Title: Single-mode shipment accepts arrival before departure
Reproduction: Enter ETD 10 Nov / ETA 1 Nov 2026 → Enter ATD 11 Nov / ATA 2 Nov 2026 → Save the otherwise valid shipment
Expected: Reject reversed planned and actual transport dates
Actual: All four contradictory dates persist in the saved shipment.
Recommended fix: Validate ETD/ETA and ATD/ATA order as well as individual date syntax.

Title: Warehousing is a configuration name without inventory operations
Reproduction: Create and activate the QA warehouse master → Look for receipts, locations, stock balances, movements, picks and dispatch allocations
Expected: Receive, store, allocate and release cargo with quantity/location traceability
Actual: Only a generic warehouse master record can be created. No stock workflow is exposed.
Recommended fix: Implement stock movements and shipment-linked receipt/pick/dispatch records.

Title: Payment entry cannot select a bank account or journal
Reproduction: Record a supplier bank transfer or customer bank receipt → Inspect payment form: no journal/account selector → Inspect General ledger entries: Cash is used
Expected: Select cash/bank journal and post to the chosen ledger
Actual: Payment forms expose amount/reference only; entries use Cash
Recommended fix: Let payments select a configured bank/cash account and journal, and reconcile against bank activity.

Title: Earlier workspace exposes placeholder modules and a separate quote data set
Reproduction: Open Earlier draft workspace → Use its ERP workspace and sidebar modules → Compare its quotation count to the main workspace
Expected: Navigation opens supported workflows and one consistent operational data set
Actual: The earlier workspace advertises incomplete workflows, several sidebar entries are placeholders, and its quotations differ from the main workspace.
Recommended fix: Remove the obsolete entry point or migrate it to the main records and real module routes.

Title: Activated tariffs are not selectable or applied to quotations
Reproduction: Create and activate the AED Dubai–Abu Dhabi sell tariff → Open a matching quotation and its charge controls → Look for rate discovery/application and validity selection
Expected: Apply the appropriate dated buy/sell tariff with its basis and source reference
Actual: Tariffs store charge lines, but quotation controls provide no tariff link or application action. Charges must be re-entered or imported manually.
Recommended fix: Add explicit tariff selection with route/date/basis matching and charge provenance.

Title: Repeated partial credits leave tax and revenue balances after full reversal
Reproduction: Post an AED 100 net + AED 5 VAT invoice → Post ten AED 10 gross credits and one AED 5 credit → Compare total credits and remaining ledger balances
Expected: {"gross_credits":"105.00","net_credits":"100.00","VAT_balance":"0.00","revenue_balance":"0.00"}
Actual: {"status":"Credited","gross_credits":"105.00","net_credits":"100.07","tax_payable_balance":0.07,"sales_revenue_balance":-0.07,"ar_credit_balance":0}
Recommended fix: Track remaining net/tax amounts and allocate final-credit rounding to fully reverse the original invoice. First credit was entered in Chrome; subsequent credits used the normal authenticated API.

Title: First row click after editing search is consumed by filter rendering
Reproduction: Type the S22 title into Search without Tab or Enter → Click its visible record number → Observe that only the filtered list appears → Click the record number again to open details
Expected: The first row click opens the selected record
Actual: Search commits on change/blur and replaces the table during the first click; no record GET occurs until the second click.
Recommended fix: Commit filtering before row activation or preserve the selected record through the filter render.
